profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: Multilingual Business Intelligence professional with a strong foundation in data-driven decision-making, user-centered design, and problem-solving through design. With a Master’s degree in Information Management and a specialization in Business Intelligence, I am passionate about leveraging technology to craft intuitive, human-centered digital experiences and actionable insights. My expertise in UX/UI design allows me to solve complex problems by creating user-friendly solutions that bridge the gap between technology and user needs. Fluent in three languages, my multicultural background provides a unique approach to both user engagement and data analysis, ensuring solutions that are both technically sound and user-focused.

positions.title: Production and Quality Control Specialist
positions.description:
- Lead cable assembly and quality testing processes, achieving an RMA rate of less than 0.5%.
- Streamlined inventory management processes, improving tracking accuracy and reducing errors by 15%.
- Demonstrated adaptability by excelling in various roles, contributing to a 10% increase in overall production output.
positions.insights: Quality Control, Cable Manufacturing and +1 skill

positions.title: UX/UI Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with teams to design user interfaces, enhancing digital transaction processes and increasing productivity by 20%.
- Conducted user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing to improve product accessibility and user satisfaction.
- Utilized Figma and Miro to develop intuitive designs aligned with business objectives.
positions.insights: User Experience (UX), User Interface Design and +3 skills

positions.title: Event Coordinator
positions.description:
- Spearheaded initiatives that enhanced campus engagement, uniting domestic and international students through collaborative events.
- Organized workshops that improved communication and leadership skills for over 200 students.

company.name: Seattle Central College - Global Engagement Team

positions.title: Customer and Sales Representative
positions.description: Dedicated to enhancing the online shopping experience, Np Commerce is an e-commerce business committed to delivering exceptional service to customers. As a key team member, I played a pivotal role in managing customer inquiries, crafting engaging eBay listings adhering to marketing guidelines, and conducting market research to identify trending items. Contributed to the overall success of the e-commerce platform by ensuring a seamless and customer-centric approach.
